coverage.headline: The sudden collapse of the value of Chain-of-Thought (even summarized CoT) in the agentic era changes working with AI.
coverage.title: The sudden collapse of the value of Chain-of-Thought (even summarized CoT) in the agentic era changes working with AI. Effectively steering AIs and getting any sort of observability now requires you to ask for interim outputs & tests, and to use AI help to troubleshoot problems you find.
